author: claude

generation.prompt:
Pixel art game sprite of the SAME young woman shown in attached image 1. Copy the face, hair, skin tone, outfit and palette from image 1.
Attached image 2 shows the outfit to draw — take only the clothes from it.
Short dark-brown bob with the bow on the image-left side of the head, cream dress with navy trim and white apron, red and navy card-suit marks, pocket watch at the image-right hip, white stockings with suit marks (the near leg's stocking shows the suit marks most clearly), navy shoes.
Do not draw any background, furniture, props or scenery from the attachments.

Draw with very large chunky pixels (each sprite pixel a crisp 25 x 25 square), about 16 colours,
about 4 heads tall (not chibi), and about half the decoration of image 1 — keep only the shapes that
make the character recognisable at small size. One full-body character, standing idle on flat ground,
three-quarter view turned slightly toward the viewer's right, arms relaxed, feet close together.
Hard edges only: no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients, no dithering noise. Dark selective outline,
simple 2-3 tone shading lit from the upper left. Keep the face readable: two clear eyes, small mouth.
Transparent background. If transparency is not possible, use one flat solid #00FF00 green with nothing else.
No ground shadow, no floor, no text, no frame, no border, no second character.
Portrait canvas 2160 x 3840.
